# shadcn-nextjs-boilerplate

> Minimal Next.js + shadcn boilerplate with a typed backend (Zod-validated), cascading middleware, and structured logging. The frontend consumes the backend via a recursive Proxy typed from the server's route tree — `useBackend()`.

## Pages

- [Home](/): landing page — overview of the boilerplate's features and links to sign-in / sign-up. Authenticated users are redirected to `/app`.

## Conventions

- [Backend rules](/docs/backend-rules.md): 12-rule guide for adding backend code — types, Zod, middleware, errors, logging, tests
- [UI Law](/docs/ui-law.md): design conventions (colors, spacing, typography, layout, backend integration)
- [File organization](/docs/organization.md): length thresholds and decision table for where new files go
- [SEO rules](/docs/seo.md): per-page metadata, semantic HTML, `llms.txt` sync
- [AI rules](/docs/ai.md): OpenRouter presets, usage tracking, test patterns

## Optional

- [README](/README.md): quick start and architecture overview
